summary: Preserve the parsed sign on NaN values in absl::from_chars.
explanation: Both FromChars.NaNDoubles and FromChars.NaNFloats exercise `-nan(tag)`. Their assertions expect `negative_from_chars_double` or `negative_from_chars_float` to have its sign bit set and to differ bitwise from the positive parse; after applying `std::copysign` to the positive value, the test expects the values to be bitwise identical. The NaN branch of `HandleEdgeCase` currently stores `MakeNan(...)` without using its `negative` argument, so the negative parse lacks the sign bit. Applying `std::copysign` with the requested sign preserves the NaN payload while restoring the contract for both types.
